description: Reverse DNS (PTR) names for an IPv4 address, and forward-confirmed reverse DNS: whether each PTR name resolves back (A record) to the same address. Up to 3 PTR names are checked. Many addresses have no PTR record; that is a normal answer. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
